newsitem.title: CROATIA: Croatian stocks flat, prices seen picking up.
newsitem.headline: Croatian stocks flat, prices seen picking up.

text.p: Croatian stocks were mostly flat on Wednesday but traders predicted that prices of major issues would pick up soon, continuing the upward trend of the past weeks.
"This looks like a short break. I think most active stocks like Podravka and Kras will move up again," Marijana Reskovac of Karlovacka Banka told Reuters.
* Of six active issues four were flat and two headed down.
* Most active food processor Podravka was flat at 235 kuna selling 2,152 shares.
* Fully listed Zagrebacka Banka, also unchanged at 740 kuna on volume of 1,212 units.
* Drugs firm Pliva was flat at 12,000 kuna on volume of 141 shares.
* Hotelier Istraturist flat at 160 kuna with 555 shares sold.
* Shipper Jadroplov, which last traded in June, lost 70 kuna to 150 selling 200 shares.
* Hotelier Laguna lost 20 kuna to 800, after peaking at 818 kuna with 51 shares changing hands.
* Total volume down at 4,311 shares, turnover slightly lower at 3.2 million kuna.
